theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (V B : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V (m + 1)), IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsOpen B → IsPreconnected B → B ⊆ V → (∀ β : TestFormOn V m, tsupport (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m) ⊆ B → X.boundary β = 0) → ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn V (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ B → X ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) (m + 1)) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
